description: IIASA researchers publish Indonesian spatial simulation units prepared for the RESTORE+ project. Zenodo supplies the version 0.1 archive free under CC BY 4.0. A national point lattice and polygon grid are paired with text attribute and domain tables describing cell areas, administrative units, terrain and soil. Grid spacing is described as approximately 9.25 kilometres near the equator. These units provide spatial inputs for biophysical and economic models of land and resource demand, with potential use in infrastructure siting simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this gridded Indonesian product. Coverage is the national grid, not parcel-scale information; cells mix conditions within their boundaries. Detailed preparation methods are linked in a separate document, while exact internal field completeness has not been checked. No archive was downloaded or model run.
name: The spatial simulation infrastructure for Indonesia v.0.1
notes: G6 item G6-1562. Metadata-only draft. Simulation-use and type tags are reviewer classifications. File contents and software execution were not checked. Unknown maturity does not assert active maintenance.
